text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing training, as we were 
heading back to the Trainer's Office...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Heyyy! Get down from that tree right now! 
At this rate, someone's gonna find—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...El-san, are you being stalked by that 
bird again?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¿Qué!? F-Flash-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I noticed that bird flying near El 
quite often, and when I asked about it..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, you see? For some reason, that 
Condor has taken a huge liking to me, 
yes~?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If someone sees me, it'll freak them out! 
I gotta get back to the dorms where my bed 
is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—I-I've been telling them to go to the 
nearby grove, but...
choice_data_list: So they won't listen, is that it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "...I see, understood. I have an idea."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then, Eishin Flash walked over to the tree 
where the bird was perched...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Nameless little bird, please listen to me. 
This place... is not your natural habitat.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You won't be able to expect food, and 
there will surely be people trying to 
chase you away... You will only suffer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: We don't want them to feel that way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The bird gave a single, plaintive 
chirpâas if deeply moved by her words.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I knew you would nod in agreement. Now, 
go... to the place where you can truly 
find peace!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (FLAP FLAP FLAP!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What in the world?! She flew straight to 
bed, yes she did! Even when I scolded her, 
she wouldn't listen at all...!
choice_data_list:
That was some masterful persuasion, wasn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. ...A long time ago, 
my parents told me. Every animal has a 
heart of its own.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Instead of scolding them as discipline, 
you should have a dialogue. Besides...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It was just easier to get my feelings 
across to that bird, I suppose. I had a 
feeling... that it would listen to me.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oooohhh!? It seems there are further 
secrets to conveying one's feelings, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to hear all the details, YES! 
Wh--... Who knows when we might encounter 
a stray condor, right?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I don't mind, but... I'm not quite 
sure how to put this sensation into words.
choice_data_list:
Maybe have them observe for a day, or 
something.
Why don't you teach them the trick?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I shall add it to tomorrow's 
schedule, then.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. Let us immediately begin by 
reviewing the agenda.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Move to the track at 5 minutes 10 seconds. 
Finish warming up at 20 minutes 50 
seconds, and you will catch a direct 
headwind during the left-handed turn.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"With this, it is possible to run under a 
load equivalent to the final straight 
where no windbreak can be expected."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Taking into account not just the time, but 
the weather too?! What an intricately 
detailed regimen...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Distance run complete. Moving to the gym 
in 5 minutes. Afterward, 23 minutes of 
pull-ups on the power rack.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohh... You ran at such incredible speed, 
and you're still full of energy...!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¿Qué!? Are you really going to eat that?! 
That food that makes exchange students 
cry... Natto!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Lunch is the fuel for the afternoon. One 
must ensure a well-balanced nutritional 
intake, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa continued observing Eishin 
Flash for the rest of the day...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
*Haaah*... With this power rack set... all 
of today's training tasks are complete.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So this is a day in the life of 
Flash-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"The scheduling, the training regimen, the 
nutritional management. Everything is so 
incredible, I'm at a loss for words, 
desu!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Still... your stoic dedication to doing 
things flawlessly. I'm sure Mambo sensed 
that, and that's why she listened to you!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I mean... I meant to say 
"thoroughly"! Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems to have served as helpful 
reference for El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A trick... If I had to name one, let's 
see.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Could it be... love?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ah... Love!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, dialogue means facing each 
other and talking things through.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In other words, instead of talking at 
them, you need an attitude of respecting 
others and listening to their opinions.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And what is needed in order to respect 
one's opponent is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Love...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You're right... All I did was scold them 
saying 'You can't do that,' without ever 
trying to hear them out.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El will love you even more! Because I want 
Mambo to stay happy and healthy forever!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ah! Aahh~! Um, um!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
M... Mambo dance! I mean directing passion 
and love like that toward, um, the condor!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That's a wonderful mindset. Good luck, I 
hope you can take steps toward a 
magnificent dialogue with that bird.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems to have served as helpful 
reference for El Condor Pasa.
